contract: v8 input-timing DATA PIN: Drosophila NON-MOTION intracellular voltage timing of R1-R6 and LMCs (training) and the Behnia 2014 medulla filters (held-out). Frozen before any v8 fit or run.
owner_rules: Per-type parameters only; fitted only to NON-MOTION recordings of input or medulla cells upstream of T4/T5; no grating, DS or behaviour; no edge changes; held-out separate; calcium is not an mV target.
answer_to_question_1: YES, a Drosophila LMC timing source exists: Mansour et al. 2026 (Supplementary Fig. 1b, printed values). The blowfly proxy (Juusola 1995) is no longer needed and is not used.

MANSOUR2026.citation: Mansour N, Takalo J, Kemppainen J, ... Juusola M (2026) Synaptic high-frequency jumping synchronises vision to high-speed behaviour. Nat Commun (published 5 May 2026). doi 10.1038/s41467-026-72509-2; PMCID PMC13144400
MANSOUR2026.licence: CC BY 4.0 (article and supplementary information); values are cited with attribution; the PDF is not redistributed
MANSOUR2026.recording: Drosophila melanogaster, 25 C, in vivo sharp-electrode intracellular voltage of R1-R6 photoreceptors (n=4) and LMCs (n=5; subtype not identified, i.e. L1/L2/L3 pooled), 10-ms bright white light flash after brief (5-15 s) dark adaptation. NON-MOTION.

R1-R6_time_to_peak_ms.where: Supp. Fig. 1b, printed in the figure ('25.5 +- 2.4 ms', 't_peak min 24.0 ms, max 29.0 ms')

LMC_time_to_peak_ms.where: Supp. Fig. 1b, printed in the figure ('12.2 +-1.1 ms', 't_peak min 11.0 ms, max 15.0 ms')

latency_ms.where: both cell types; 'no measurable synaptic delay'

LMC_peaks_before_R_ms.where: main text and Supp. Note I.1

MANSOUR2026.verification: values read from the figure's printed numerals (raster), checked on a 300 dpi render; legend and main-text statements extracted as text. The +- dispersion type is not stated (probably s.d.).
MANSOUR2026.caveats: single condition (dark-adapted saturating flash); LMC subtype pooled; the absolute flash intensity is not given in photons (mapped by assumption, see prereg); n small

JH2001.citation: Juusola M, Hardie RC (2001) J Gen Physiol 117(1):3-25, doi 10.1085/jgp.117.1.3, PMC2232468 (already pinned in v6 S0, sha256 42f51f59...2593)
JH2001.licence: CC BY-NC-SA; only numbers stated in the text are used, with location
JH2001.recording: Drosophila R1-R6 intracellular, 25 C, light impulses on backgrounds BG-4..BG0 (BG0 ~3e6 photons/s). NON-MOTION.

impulse_time_to_peak_ms.where: Results, Fig. 6H text: 'halved from ~40 ms measured at the lowest mean light intensity to ~20 ms at the brightest adapting background'

dead_time_ms.where: Results, Fig. 6D text: 'reduces with light adaptation from values close to 20 ms at BG-4 to ~10 ms at BG0'

JH2001.caveats: endpoints only; intermediate backgrounds are NOT interpolated; the paper's dead-time definition (first quantum bumps) differs from the model's 10 %-of-peak onset (disclosed)

context_not_used_as_targets.ZHENG2006: doi 10.1085/jgp.200509470 (pinned in v6 S0): one example, R begins to depolarise 9 ms after light onset, followed by the LMC hyperpolarisation; condition-specific single trace, superseded by MANSOUR2026 population values
context_not_used_as_targets.ZHENG2009_I: Zheng L et al. (2009) PLoS ONE 4:e4307, doi 10.1371/journal.pone.0004307, PMC2628724, CC BY (sha256 9c8479db...017e): LMC minimum integration time 5-50 ms depending on mean luminance; qualitative range, not a target
context_not_used_as_targets.JUUSOLA1995: blowfly; cross-species proxy, NOT used now that a Drosophila source is pinned
context_not_used_as_targets.searched_without_timing_values: Nikolaev 2009 PLoS ONE II (PMC2628722), Dau 2016 Front Neural Circuits (PMC4801898): no LMC onset/time-to-peak values in text; Behnia 2014 Extended Data has no LMC recordings

heldout.BEHNIA2014_FIG3: Mi1/Tm3/Tm1/Tm2 voltage-filter peak times from the v7 pin (qualification/v7/V7_data_pin_v2.json, sha256 61ee0c83...9d84; digitised CSVs 14f73ec0/c4d37fa6/df689183/7f460fe9; text means 71+-3.8, 53+-5.2, 56+-3.8, 43+-2.7 ms) and the filter shapes. Different lab, cells and method from the training data. NOT blind: the analyst has seen these values and the v7 F1.
